what the Lean kernel checks, against what each paper claims
325 Complete Crouzeix, constant 2, any Hilbert space
MATCHES
Lean: the complete (matrix-coefficient) Crouzeix bound with constant 2 for every
bounded operator, plus sharpness
Gap: none at the statement level; the contour calculus's else-0 branch is excluded
by the conclusion
statement read by: confluence, fixpoint, lattice
049 Abhyankar-Sathaye and stable coordinates
MATCHES
Lean: for every n >= 4 an F with C[x]/(F) = C[n-1 variables] that no automorphism
makes a variable; and an explicit degree-5 f, a coordinate after adjoining one
variable, not in four
Gap: none for the collection's claims; docs/049: the three-variable case is not
covered
statement read by: confluence, fixpoint
100 Triangular cylinders cover a tetrahedron for under half
NARROWER
Lean: a small-epsilon family of 2 ceil(2/eps^2) cylinders covering the regular
tetrahedron at total cost below 1/2 of the shadow
Gap: regular tetrahedron and 'sufficiently small' eps with an unspecified O(eps^4)
constant; the paper's corollary covers every tetrahedron
statement read by: confluence, lattice
191 A power improvement in the Heilbronn triangle lower bound
NARROWER
Lean: an unbounded sequence of n with n-point sets whose triangles all have area
Gap: docs/191: 'the linked construction is for an unbounded sequence of sizes; the
paper's statement for every sufficiently large n is broader'
statement read by: lattice, confluence
261 Pure point spectrum for the 2D Anderson model

Lean: almost surely the 2D Anderson operator with uniform disorder on [-h, h] has
